title: Domain Registrations Plan Allowance on Price-Matched Manual Renewals, by Web Hosting Plans Tier
content:
Under the Domain Care programme of Harborline Hosting & Domains, the manual line's plan allowance is one of the charge's Domain Care credits of a manual renewal charge on a Domain Registrations domain. Its size depends on which Web Hosting Plans plan is active for the domain as its primary domain.

## Allowance schedule

The manual line's plan allowance is:

1. where the active Harborline hosting plan whose primary domain is this domain is a **Harborline Business, Harborline Cloud 4 or Harborline Cloud 8** plan: the amount by which the TLD's renewal price exceeds its registration price, for each year the charge covered, that amount being never less than **USD 0.75 for each year the charge covered**, also where the renewal price does not exceed the registration price;
2. where that active plan is a **Harborline Starter, Harborline Plus or Harborline Pro** plan: the flat **USD 0.75 once for the charge**, whatever the TLD's prices and however many years the charge covered;
3. where no such plan is active: **nothing**.

The renewal price and registration price are the TLD's own figures in the Domain Registrations price schedule.

## Decision table

| Active plan for this primary domain | Allowance per charge |
|---|---|
| Harborline Business, Cloud 4 or Cloud 8 | the higher of (renewal price less registration price) and USD 0.75, for each year the charge covered |
| Harborline Starter, Plus or Pro | USD 0.75 once |
| none active | nothing |

## Hypothetical cases (figures invented for illustration, not any TLD's prices)

- Renewal price USD 40.00, registration price USD 30.00, charge covering 2 years, active Harborline Cloud 8 plan: USD 10.00 for each year, USD 20.00 in all.
- Renewal price USD 30.40, registration price USD 30.00, charge covering 2 years, active Harborline Business plan: the excess of USD 0.40 is below USD 0.75, so USD 0.75 for each year, USD 1.50 in all.
- Renewal price USD 30.00, registration price USD 31.00, 1 year, active Harborline Cloud 4 plan: no excess, so USD 0.75.
- Any prices, charge covering 4 years, active Harborline Plus plan: USD 0.75 once.
